# nowtb.com

## Purpose
The official real estate website of Barrett Henry, REALTOR® and Broker Associate at REMAX Collective. Barrett leads The NOW Team, serving buyers, sellers, and investors across Tampa Bay, Florida.

## Authority
- Barrett Henry, licensed Florida REALTOR® and Broker Associate
- Florida Real Estate Broker License #BK3313308
- 23+ years of real estate experience
- Team leader of The NOW Team at REMAX Collective
- REMAX Hall of Fame (2024), 10-Year Anniversary Award
- Designations: e-PRO, MRP (Military Relocation Professional), SRS (Seller Representative Specialist)
- Serves Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Polk, Manatee, Sarasota, and Hernando counties

## Priority Cities Served
Valrico, Brandon, Riverview, Lithia, Apollo Beach, Seffner, Plant City, Dover, Thonotosassa, Ruskin

## Content Areas
- Tampa Bay homes for sale (live Stellar MLS listings via the Bridge Data Output API, refreshed hourly)
- Home buying guides (first-time buyers, VA loans, FHA loans, conventional, USDA)
- Home selling guides (pricing strategy, staging, marketing, FSBO vs. REALTOR)
- Free home valuation / comparative market analysis (CMA)
- Real estate investing (rental properties, 1031 exchanges, short-term rentals)
- Luxury homes ($750K+)
- City and neighborhood guides (69+ cities, 460+ neighborhoods)
- Market reports and data
- Open houses
- New construction / builder communities
- Property management referrals (ViVi PM)
- Relocation services (military PCS, out-of-state moves)
- Mortgage calculator
- Commercial real estate

## Pinellas Gulf Beach Condo Guides (updated October 2026)
Building-level research on Gulf-front condos from Indian Rocks Beach to Madeira Beach,
covering Structural Integrity Reserve Study (SIRS) status, milestone inspections,
Florida condo law, rental rules, and purchase structure.
- /gulf-front-condos-sirs-milestone-complete — Which Gulf-front buildings have a filed SIRS and a completed milestone inspection
- /pinellas-beach-condo-market-report — Q4 2026 Gulf beach condo market report: inventory, price per square foot, days on market
- /florida-condo-rules-buyers-2026 — Florida condo rules for buyers in 2026: HB 913, SIRS deadlines, Fannie Mae LL-2026-03, Citizens SB 1028
- /indian-rocks-beach-rental-rules — Indian Rocks Beach vacation rental rules under Ordinance 2023-02, plus building minimum stays
- /buying-beach-condo-llc-florida — Buying a Florida beach condo in an LLC: financing, association approval, taxes, document checklist
- /beach-condo-renovation-math — Renovation cost estimates for a dated Gulf-front condo versus buying updated
- /how-to-tell-if-condo-is-55-plus — How to verify whether a Florida condo is age restricted
